title: Leaving Goodman and the job offers
summary: After quitting Benny's band, Basie, Woody Herman and others offered jobs, but he decided to stay in New York.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: And it was the surprise of my life when I left Benny's band. Benny had me so buffaloed I didn't think anybody would hire me. And within a week of quitting the band it seemed

like everybody in the country offered -- Basie offered me a job. And I said, why didn't you ever ask me before, for God's sake? And he said, "I couldn't afford to pay you." And I said, "you've offered me $100.00 a week more than Benny's playing me." He said, "I don't believe it." And I said, "That's right."
Woody Herman, everybody offered me jobs. But I determined to stay in town.
